coverage_note: 210 distinct synthetic application fixtures: 30 per journey, each with a validated real-service request payload. Previously unrepresentable cases were re-authored while retaining case IDs: unsupported job metadata becomes case-specific no-claim/abstention criteria; comparisons use explicit authorized synthetic snapshots and stored matching facts; derived analysis uses only supplied refs and available/unknown components. CV_LOCALIZATION uses CvDraftRequest and application-owned whole-CV draft/localization stages, never arbitrary ProviderLocalizedItems keys. Every case ID, UUID, employer/title placeholder, CV snapshot, content hash, analysis version key and synthetic-fixture-only-v1 consent marker is dataset-only synthetic data, not a real record, authorization or human consent. Citation keys are source aliases, never canonical IDs. Comparison scores and retrieval scores are declared synthetic fixture inputs, not production calculations, live retrieval or provider judgments; no scoring breakdown may be inferred when absent. Analysis numbers encode stated qualitative signals and coverage counts; unavailable components are null and compatibility has zero weight. A required zero overall with all components unavailable is contract scaffolding, not a reliable match result or ability judgment. Unknown company/title labels are fixture placeholders, not known business facts. Offline dataset/model validation does not establish application execution, first-pass generation success, human acceptance or release readiness; provider quality requires separate execution and independent review.
